rules.cdn_fetch: Latest release publishes a py3-none-any or py2.py3-none-any wheel and has no runtime requires_dist outside extras and environment markers that are false on the repo's Python floor. Same gate as Aoi scripts/fetch_module.py (PR 87), plus marker evaluation, which that script does not do yet.
rules.shrink_min: No qualifying pure wheel, but the production call surface read from the source is small enough to reimplement in a stdlib <pkg>_min.py the way Aoi shrink/numpy_min.py covers load_overlap (PR 89). Attribute counts from AST under-count methods on returned values; those methods are included when the source was read.
rules.not_handed_off: Test harnesses, optional accelerators that already fall back to the stdlib, vendored copies of archived templates, frameworks that are the product, and Aoi packages owned by other agents.
